scope: First full-length launch on the historical a800-4 benchmark host
summary: Both persistent workers stopped before model allocation because setting an explicit rendezvous address disabled the upstream fallback while RANK and WORLD_SIZE were absent.
evidence: Both disjoint GPU-pair workers exited with KeyError: RANK in the pinned upstream Wan-Animate-2 pipeline.
The experiment ran from 2026-08-12T04:45:34Z to 04:46:47Z and produced no generated window.
lessons: Distributed subprocesses must receive a complete explicit MASTER_ADDR, MASTER_PORT, RANK, and WORLD_SIZE contract rather than a partial environment.
limitations: This attempt contains no generation throughput or visual-quality evidence.
next_actions: Set RANK=0 and WORLD_SIZE=1 for each independent two-GPU pipeline controller and rerun in a fresh directory.
